Oswal Pumps Wins Large Orders, Share Price Rises

Oswal Pumps' share price increased by 8% after the company announced it had secured orders totaling ₹273.19 crore from TGREDCO and ₹297.50 crore from TREDCL. The TGREDCO order is for rooftop solar power plants in 9,937 government schools in Telangana, supporting the state's renewable energy initiatives. The TREDCL order details were not specified in the provided coverage.
